name: io.github.cammac-creator/ibanforge
description: Check the bank behind an IBAN before you pay: bank-code check, BIC with source, bank-level sanctions

environmentVariables.name: IBANFORGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bearer ifk_* API key. A free key needs no e-mail: POST https://api.ibanforge.com/v1/keys/generate with an empty body.

environmentVariables.name: IBANFORGE_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (default https://api.ibanforge.com).
